column2: ACCRA THREADS — CANVA BULK CREATION GUIDE
Product Catalog Spreadsheet  •  208 SKUs across 4 Categories

column4: Go to canva.com → open your product card template
In the left toolbar → Apps → Bulk Create
Choose 'Upload CSV or Excel' → select this file
Choose the category sheet you want (Men's, Women's, etc.)

Drag each column header to its matching element in your design:
• Product_Name → Title text
• Price_GHS → Price text
• Badge → Badge/label element
• Short_Description → Subtitle text
• Colors_Available → Colour info text
• Sizes_Available → Sizes text
• SKU → Order code text
• Collection_Tag → Collection label
• Canva_Image_Keyword → Use as image search hint
Click 'Generate X designs' — one card per row
Edit individual cards if needed → Export as PNG/PDF
WHAT IT MAPS TO IN CANVA
Badge overlay: NEW | SALE | LIMITED | ARTISAN | HERITAGE | FEATURED
